description: What `GET /documents` is filtered and paged by.

after.description: Only documents newer than this one, by its id.

before.description: Only documents older than this one, by its id.

label.description: `key:value` for documents whose label `key` is `value`, or `key` alone for those carrying it.

limit.description: At most this many: 30 where none is given, 200 at most.

picture.description: `true` for the documents keeping a picture alone, those `hasPicture` marks.

q.description: A phrase matched whole and without regard to case in the title, the labels and the body.
